## Fixed
- Android TV: the music player's progress bar now seeks with Left and Right on the remote, in every slider style
- Android TV: the remote's arrows no longer seek or change the volume in the music player when the TV reports a keyboard
- Android TV: long descriptions scroll a step at a time with the remote, and text no longer takes invisible focus
- Android TV: the selection bar in Downloads and playlists takes focus as soon as it opens

## New
- Android TV: hold OK or press Menu on a song in the queue to play it next, move it or remove it
- Android TV: Move up and Move down buttons replace drag handles, so tabs, playlists, groups, lyrics providers and the video queue can be reordered with the remote
- Android TV: Left and Right turn the pages of a Recap story
